# LiveShell Engine (built into Home Hider)

**LiveShell Engine** by **ZiZc3**: animated video wallpapers for the PS5 home screen.
Project: https://github.com/ZiZc3/LiveShell
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (see `source/LICENSE`)

Home Hider carries this copy unchanged:

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `liveshell.elf` | LiveShell Engine 1.5.2 payload, as released by ZiZc3. SHA-256 `6c71e163d2b31d7db1dee64afeb0af122b9cc04c52f30579b83bffc8a2ffb6e6` |
| `source/` | LiveShell 1.5.2 source code (corresponding source for `liveshell.elf`) |

LiveShell is built on [OnionHEN](https://github.com/aydencharles/onionHEN) v0.9.0-beta2 (payload injector, detour library and ShellUI groundwork) with the [PS5 Payload SDK](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/sdk). See `source/README.md` for how to build it.

## How Home Hider uses it

The build embeds `liveshell.elf` into `HomeHider.elf` (`src/liveshell_elf.h`, generated by `tools/embed.py`). When **Live wallpaper** is switched on, Home Hider hands those exact bytes to the ELF loader, the same as loading `liveshell.elf` from Payload Manager. Home Hider's menu then talks to LiveShell's own web API on `127.0.0.1:9050` (`/api/state`, `/api/select`, `/api/delete`, `/thumb`, `/api/shutdown`) and links to LiveShell's page for everything else.

## Updating to a newer LiveShell

1. Replace `liveshell.elf` and `source/` with the new release and its source.
2. Set `LIVESHELL_VERSION` in `src/liveshell.h` and update the SHA-256 above.
3. Run `make test` (it checks that the exact bytes reach the ELF loader), then `make`.
